slots.name: Jackson support

slots.name: undecided voters
slots.sentence: A sizable 10% of voters say they could still change their minds — another dynamic that underscores that this could still break either way.

slots.name: sample size
slots.sentence: This CBS News/YouGov survey was conducted with a representative sample of 1,144 registered voters in Maine interviewed between September 23rd -October 1, 2026.

slots.name: poll margin error
slots.sentence: The margin of error is ± 4.7 points for registered voters.

slots.name: poll status
slots.sentence: Collins is drawing enough voters and enough of Maine's Democrats, while she is bolstered by those who say they're voting more on state matters than national ones, to keep the race at a tie.

slots.name: democrat nominee disapproval
slots.sentence: Jackson may be feeling the effects of the primary season: four in 10 Democrats and most independents wish someone else were the Democratic nominee.
